_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: uppercase-snake-case placeholders are replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.
